scope: Integrate the six drafted topics (96 slots); other four topics unchanged. IDs, topic order, date selector, timers, score formula and captured snapshots are preserved.
ratings: Fixed editorial order from familiar to less obvious; evenly spread integer 1–100 ratings. Kanto uses a curated familiar prefix then the remaining Pokedex order. Questions with more than 100 answers necessarily share integer ratings. These are design choices, not measured popularity.
corrections: Commonwealth: remove duplicate Saint Kitts and Nevis; add Brunei.
Constellations: replace invalid Borealis with Cepheus.
Star Wars: merge Anakin/Vader and Ilum/Starkiller Base aliases.
Doctor Who: remove individual Sutekh, repair Monoid, deduplicate Sontaran; Slitheen aliases its species.
Merge Te Ka/Te Fiti; add common player, team, title and spelling aliases.
Exclude Iron Man 3, Muppets from Space and Space Jam from physical space-trip films.
NASA: exclude SLS hardware; Mars missions include Spirit and Opportunity.
Keep all 151 Kanto species; expand browser/SQL bound to 160 rather than truncating.
limits: Editorial scope review and matching checks do not independently verify every linked source or establish human difficulty calibration.
